items.title: Peter Erskine interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Orleans, Louisiana, January 9, 2020
items.q: Jaco was 26 or 27. I mean we were basically about half the age of Joe and Wayne. And so we’re playing this fast and rather furious thing and then Jaco would kind of walk over

ctx.x: Well yeah, that whole band was a workout, that whole experience. So we are touring, I talk about this in my book. After “Birdland” there would be two or three more tunes — you know there were built-in encores and stuff. And we get to the last tune. It was a medley of two compositions of Joe’s, “Badia” and “Boogie Woogie Waltz.” And it goes into this very fast double time [scats]. And, because I was 24, 25, Jaco was 26 or 27. I mean we were basically about half the age of Joe and Wayne. And so we’re playing this…
